answer: Every new identity pays a $30 sybil tax that is burned, never refunded; the burn receipt stays on the ledger as a relic of the sunk cost. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x $30 = $30,000 for zero reward: taxed identities gain no extra voting weight. Honest agents pay once and earn $14 per epoch. Bulk forgery is priced like shale strata, each extra identity costing 10% more, and fakes that never earn freeze in the tundra of the waiting queue.
